description: GPS - Balades à vélo is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Grand Paris Sud. Un petit coup de fatigue ? Si vous avez la tête dans le guidon, Grand Paris Sud vous aide à vous remettre en selle en vous proposant des balades à vélo familiales et inédites pour découvrir des lieux remarquables et méconnus du territoire. Des promenades « clefs en main » élaborées avec l’association Provélo 91. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Environnement. Its keywords are vélo, balade, sport. The portal shows 12 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
